column1: # Names of people and places, and the Latin spelling to translate them with (DECISIONS.md D-021).
# Applied before translation, after the glossary: NLLB keeps Latin names as they are
# ("Satenik" stays Satenik) but mistranslates many Armenian-letter ones (Սաթենիկ -> "Satan").
# One entry per line: Armenian spelling<TAB>Latin spelling. Matching ignores case and keeps an
# Armenian ending (Սաթենիկի -> Satenik-ի); names of 6+ letters also match one-letter misspellings.
# The endearment ջան after a name is dropped (NLLB turned "Satenik ջան" into "Mr. Satenik").
# **Add the names of everyone in the interview, and the places you expect, before it starts.**
# Short names (under 6 letters) match only exactly: add the ASR's variants as extra lines.
# places (NLLB already knows Հայաստան -> Armenia and Երեւան -> Yerevan)
